versions.name: Camp Seminole
versions.summary: A year-round Natchez Trace Council resident camp north of Starkville in eastern Mississippi, offering tent and limited cabin camping, a dining hall, a fishing and boating lake, and shooting ranges.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Natchez Trace Council facilities page, which describes Camp Seminole as a current year-round resident camping facility (the source's 'Pushmataha Area Council' label is superseded — that council merged into Natchez Trace Council). Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own facilities page; classified as a year-round Scouts BSA resident camp; features unsurveyed.
